title: Quit to character select from the world without a password, and play again from where the wizard stood
notes: 5.06: after the Ravenwood entry of enter-world.json the run walks the wizard and chooses Quit from the in-world menu.
The game server writes where the wizard stood and marks it offline; the client goes back to the login server and
sends MSG_USER_VALIDATE with a PassKey3 made from the session key its first login was given and this connection's
offer, which the login server checks against the key it keeps and answers with MSG_USER_VALIDATE_RSP Error=0 and
MSG_USER_ADMIT_IND, so the character list follows with no password typed. The run checks the wizard is offline in
the characters database and gone from realm_online_character, presses Play again and passes only if the game
server puts the wizard back at the very place it wrote.
The logout is intentional, so the game server saves the wizard and marks it offline the moment its client closes, never holding it link-dead; the save must come within 15 seconds of Quit.

steps.name: the game server writes where the wizard stood as it leaves
the client comes back to the login server with MSG_USER_VALIDATE
steps.pattern: sent MSG_USER_VALIDATE: user (\d+), machine [0-9A-F]+, locale \S+, patch client .*, (\d+)-byte PassKey3

steps.name: the login server validates the PassKey3
steps.pattern: validated as {user} \(id \d+\) on machine [0-9A-F]+: sent MSG_USER_VALIDATE_RSP Error=0 and MSG_USER_ADMIT_IND Status=1

steps.name: the client is admitted again
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the server lists the wizard again
the character selection screen is back with no password asked
the wizard on the character selection screen again
the wizard is no longer listed online in any realm

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server puts the wizard back where it stood
the client loads Ravenwood again
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the wizard standing in Ravenwood again
